resources.string: Connect this device to the same Wi-Fi to find devices.
Looking for devices on this Wi-Fi…
Could not determine the local network range.
No devices found on the current Wi-Fi network.
Write a message or attach at least one file.
The channel requires a Wi-Fi connection.
Join the Wi-Fi channel to write.
No other devices are in the channel to receive files.
Message posted to the Wi-Fi channel.
Message and files queued to send.
Invalid destination: you cannot send to this device itself. Choose another device or clear that IP.
The current session is invalid. Sync the session code and PIN with the other device or create a new session.
No previous destination has been saved yet.
For now, the Wi-Fi Direct host can send files to one device at a time.
Wi-Fi Direct clients can send files directly to the host only.
Direct device ready. You can send files or chat.
Wi-Fi Direct link ready. Waiting for the other device.
Direct connection ready. The session syncs automatically.
Wi-Fi is ready. Find devices; the session will sync when a device is ready.
Turn on Wi-Fi or Wi-Fi Direct to find devices.
Quick start: 1) One device creates the link. 2) The other finds it and connects.
Could not sync automatically. Use Sync session.
Could not sync the session automatically.
A sync is already in progress.
Could not find the other device\'s IP address.
Enter or find the other device\'s IP address to sync the session.
This device shares the session. The other device will receive it when it connects.
Check the device, session code and PIN before continuing.
Session prepared with the details you confirmed.
No valid text in the clipboard.
Connecting to the other device and preparing to sync…
The session is closed. Tap Enable session to connect or send again.
The device has not been confirmed on this Wi-Fi Direct link yet. Keep Qetara open on both devices. If it does not progress, disconnect and reconnect them.
The Wi-Fi Direct link changed. Return to Connect, check the destination device and send again.
That device is not part of the current Wi-Fi Direct link. Choose a device in the group or switch to Same Wi-Fi to connect over the local network.
This device needs manual pairing. In Connect, open Credentials and enter the session code and PIN shown on the other device.
The other device must approve the connection. Compare the fingerprint, wait for approval and try again.
The other device is not trusted yet. Accept the trust request in Qetara and try again.
This device\'s identity changed. Check its fingerprint in About Qetara. If it is your device, go to Connect, Manage remembered devices and forget it before connecting again.
The session code or PIN does not match. Sync the session with the other device and send again.
The session expired. Renew it in Qetara before continuing.
A required permission is missing. Check nearby Wi-Fi and notification permissions, then try again.
The other device\'s receiver is inactive or rejected the connection. Open Qetara there and enable the session.
That IP address could not be found on the network. Check that both devices are on the same Wi-Fi or use Wi-Fi Direct.
The other device did not respond in time. Move the devices closer, check the network and try again.
The connection was interrupted during the transfer. Keep both apps open and try again.
File verification failed. Qetara discarded the incomplete copy. Send it again.
Could not complete the connection. Check the IP address, network and that Qetara is active on the other device.
Could not sync credentials. Check the connection and try again.
Open Android Settings, Qetara, then Permissions to allow nearby devices.
Files and messages between your devices over your local network or Wi-Fi Direct. Transfers need no account or cloud server.
An open source project by Experience Lab, created by Intelog Natanael.
Received files are in Downloads. Activity and messages are stored on this device.
Session enabled. You can now connect a device.
Session closed. Receiving and operations stopped.
Device forgotten. You will need to approve it again to connect.
Could not find the file details.
Could not find the IP address of the device that shared it.
Enable the session to connect or send.
Could not determine the destination IP to %1$s.
Wi-Fi Direct permission or a Wi-Fi connection is required to %1$s. Grant permission or use the Wi-Fi channel on the same network.
Connect through Wi-Fi Direct or the same Wi-Fi network before you %1$s. Start a host/client or select a LAN device.
Could not determine the destination IP to %1$s. Choose a discovered device or enter the IP manually.
The session expired. Renew it before you %1$s.
You declined to share the session with %1$s.
